critical_code_review_comments: RoundTable.jsx: onPointerUp closure reads dragIdx/hover from state; because pointer events are handled on the source element via setPointerCapture, this works in practice, but a very rapid programmatic burst (all events in one JS tick) can drop the swap since React batches state updates. Real user drags are unaffected. Consider using a ref for dragIdx/hover for defensive coding.
server.py is now 865 lines — still worth splitting into routers (auth/matches/rules/awards) for maintainability.
MatchDetail.jsx renders both MatchRoundTable and a list of participant rows below — a small amount of duplicated info (name/placement/exit card). Acceptable but could be collapsed on mobile.

MatchRoundTable positions players by table_position order using POSITION_ORDER; if a match saves a table_position not in that list they fall to index 99 — currently fine since positions endpoint is the source, but keep in sync if positions are ever renamed.
